decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a range of speakers from budget outdoor options to high-end audiophile devices. I narrowed my consideration set to the Bose SoundLink Color for its balance of performance and price, the BOGASING M4 for its high wattage value, the JBL Pulse 4 and Bang & Olufsen for premium quality, and the Altec Lansing for rugged portability. Ultimately, I chose the Bose SoundLink Color because of its exceptional track record (4.6 rating with 9.6k reviews) and reasonable $99 price point for a reputable brand known for sound quality.
